problem:
$$
{x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}]x(t)
$$

Consider the system of linear differential equations above.
Find the unknown function $f(t)$ in the general solution to the system, shown below.

$$
\text{x}(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}-\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]{e}^{t}+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}f(t) \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]{e}^{t}
$$

*Hint: One of the eigenvalues of the matrix is ${\lambda }_{1}=1+2\text{i}.$*

activity_context.topic_title: Solving Homogeneous Systems of ODEs With Complex Eigenvalues
